headline: Copper Prices Post Strongest Surge in Months on Renewed Risk Appetite
summary: Copper prices jumped over 3.5% on the London Metal Exchange, putting the industrial metal on track for its first weekly gain in seven weeks as equity markets recovered from an AI-driven selloff.
why: Copper is a foundational industrial commodity widely used in manufacturing, construction, and electronics, acting as a key barometer for global economic health.
why_moved: A broad stabilization in investor risk appetite following an artificial intelligence stock correction spurred aggressive buying across industrial metals.
